package example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates

import akka.actor.typed.ActorRef
import akka.persistence.typed.scaladsl.Effect
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundOrderEntity.{Event, State}
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.values._
import net.imadz.common.CborSerializable
import net.imadz.common.CommonTypes.iMadzError

object FundOrderProtocol {

  sealed trait Command extends CborSerializable
  final case class RecordCashRequestSource(
    principal: String,
    clientRequestId: String,
    fundCode: String,
    amount: Money,
    replyTo: ActorRef[Reply]
  ) extends Command
  final case class RequestFundPurchaseSettlement(
    principal: String,
    clientRequestId: String,
    fundCode: String,
    amount: Money,
    replyTo: ActorRef[Reply]
  ) extends Command
  final case class RecordFundTAConfirmed(
    shares: Long,
    nav: BigDecimal,
    replyTo: ActorRef[Reply]
  ) extends Command
  final case class RequestIndependentRefund(orderId: String, replyTo: ActorRef[Reply]) extends Command
  final case class GetState(replyTo: ActorRef[State]) extends Command

  sealed trait Reply extends CborSerializable
  final case class Accepted(events: Vector[Event]) extends Reply
  final case class Refused(error: iMadzError) extends Reply {
    def code: String = error.code
  }

  type CommandHandler = (State, Command) => Effect[Event, State]
}
